knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Each pump needs its own record with a unique identifier, its location and its own service history. Merging identical items makes it unclear which one was serviced.
Corrections are dated additions, keeping the original visible.
The lesson says an entry that says the pump was serviced needs evidence: the date, the worker, and the work done.

passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Capture unique asset IDs, location, condition, last service date and evidence, and avoid overwriting the older record.
Describe the responsible referral and documentary trail
stopWorkCriteria: Confusing assets and marking the wrong equipment as serviced.
